reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Iowa
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that eviction was retaliatory?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic domain facts (scenario-independent)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

jurisdiction(iowa).
focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Parties
landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).

% Eviction action (action for possession).
action(eviction_action1).
action_type(eviction_action1, possession).
action_by(eviction_action1, landlord1).
action_against(eviction_action1, tenant1).

% Tenant intends to raise/plead the defense that the eviction is retaliatory.
tenant_raises_defense(tenant1, retaliatory_eviction, eviction_action1).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario statement is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(iowa),
    focus_year(2021),
    action(eviction_action1),
    action_type(eviction_action1, possession),
    action_by(eviction_action1, landlord1),
    action_against(eviction_action1, tenant1),
    tenant_raises_defense(tenant1, retaliatory_eviction, eviction_action1).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Utility predicates
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% within_one_year(YearOfEvent1, YearOfEvent2) holds if Event1 occurred within 1 year prior to Event2.
within_one_year(Year1, Year2) :-
    integer(Year1),
    integer(Year2),
    Year1 =< Year2,
    Year2 - Year1 =< 1.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (Iowa Code, 2021)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
 [1] IA Code  562A.24 (2021)
 Landlord's noncompliance as defense/counterclaim in certain actions.
*/
statute_562a24_tenant_may_counterclaim_in_possession_or_rent_action(State, Year) :-
    State = iowa,
    Year = 2021,
    !.

statute_562a24_applies_to_action_kind(possession_based_on_nonpayment_of_rent).
statute_562a24_applies_to_action_kind(rent_action_tenant_in_possession).
statute_562a24_applies_to_action_kind(rent_action_tenant_not_in_possession).

/*
 [2] IA Code  562A.15 (2021)
 Landlord to maintain fit premises (core duties).
*/
statute_562a15_landlord_duty(State, Year, comply_building_housing_codes_health_safety) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.
statute_562a15_landlord_duty(State, Year, make_repairs_keep_fit_habitable) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.
statute_562a15_landlord_duty(State, Year, keep_common_areas_clean_safe) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.
statute_562a15_landlord_duty(State, Year, maintain_facilities_electrical_plumbing_heating_etc) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.
statute_562a15_landlord_duty(State, Year, provide_garbage_receptacles_and_removal) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.
statute_562a15_landlord_duty(State, Year, supply_running_water_hot_water_reasonable_heat_with_exceptions) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.

/*
 [3] IA Code  562A.21 (2021)
 Noncompliance by landlord-general (notice/termination; damages/injunction).
*/
statute_562a21_tenant_may_terminate_after_notice_if_material_landlord_noncompliance(State, Year) :-
    State = iowa,
    Year = 2021,
    !.

statute_562a21_notice_min_days(7).

statute_562a21_tenant_may_recover_damages_or_injunctive_relief_for_landlord_noncompliance(State, Year) :-
    State = iowa,
    Year = 2021,
    !.

/*
 [4] IA Code  562A.26 (2021)
 Tenant's remedies for unlawful ouster/exclusion/diminution of essential services.
*/
statute_562a26_tenant_remedies_for_unlawful_ouster_or_service_diminution(State, Year) :-
    State = iowa,
    Year = 2021,
    !.

/*
 [5] IA Code  562A.36 (2021)
 Retaliatory conduct prohibited; defense in action for possession; presumption; exceptions.
*/

% 562A.36(1): retaliatory actions prohibited after certain tenant activities.
statute_562a36_prohibited_retaliation_action(State, Year, increase_rent) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.
statute_562a36_prohibited_retaliation_action(State, Year, decrease_services) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.
statute_562a36_prohibited_retaliation_action(State, Year, bring_or_threaten_possession_action) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.

% 562A.36(1)(a)-(c): protected tenant activities.
statute_562a36_protected_activity(State, Year, complaint_to_government_agency_building_or_housing_code_health_safety) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.
statute_562a36_protected_activity(State, Year, complaint_to_landlord_of_violation_under_562a15) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.
statute_562a36_protected_activity(State, Year, organized_or_joined_tenants_union) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.

% 562A.36(2): If landlord violates (1), tenant has a defense in action for possession.
statute_562a36_tenant_has_defense_in_possession_action(State, Year) :-
    State = iowa,
    Year = 2021,
    !.

% 562A.36(2): presumption from evidence of good-faith complaint within 1 year prior.
statute_562a36_presumption_of_retaliation_applies(State, Year, ComplaintYear, ActYear, ComplaintMadeAfterNoticeOfProposedIncreaseOrDiminution) :-
    State = iowa,
    Year = 2021,
    within_one_year(ComplaintYear, ActYear),
    ComplaintMadeAfterNoticeOfProposedIncreaseOrDiminution = no,
    !.

statute_562a36_presumption_of_retaliation_applies(_State, _Year, _ComplaintYear, _ActYear, ComplaintMadeAfterNoticeOfProposedIncreaseOrDiminution) :-
    % If complaint was made after notice of proposed rent increase/diminution,
    % the presumption does not arise.
    ComplaintMadeAfterNoticeOfProposedIncreaseOrDiminution = yes,
    !,
    fail.

% 562A.36(2): defense against presumption when legitimate cost increases justify commensurate rent increase.
statute_562a36_landlord_defense_against_presumption(State, Year, legitimate_costs_increased, rent_increase_commensurate) :-
    State = iowa,
    Year = 2021,
    !.

% 562A.36(3): notwithstanding (1)-(2), landlord may bring action for possession if any exception applies.
statute_562a36_exception_allowing_possession_action(State, Year, code_violation_caused_primarily_by_tenant_lack_of_reasonable_care) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.
statute_562a36_exception_allowing_possession_action(State, Year, tenant_in_default_in_rent) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.
statute_562a36_exception_allowing_possession_action(State, Year, code_compliance_requires_alteration_remodeling_or_demolition_depriving_use) :-
    State = iowa, Year = 2021, !.

/*
 [6] IA Code  562A.27 (2021)
 Tenant noncompliance; nonpayment; notice; and limited defense in nonpayment possession actions.
*/
statute_562a27_landlord_may_terminate_for_nonpayment_after_3_day_notice(State, Year) :-
    State = iowa,
    Year = 2021,
    !.

statute_562a27_nonpayment_notice_days(3).

statute_562a27_repair_and_deduct_defense_available(State, Year) :-
    State = iowa,
    Year = 2021,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning helpers for this question
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Recognized defenses in an Iowa action for possession (2021), as to retaliation.
% This predicate is intentionally about the legal availability/recognition of the defense,
% not whether it will succeed on the merits in a given case.
legal_defense_recognized_in_possession_action(State, Year, retaliatory_eviction) :-
    statute_562a36_tenant_has_defense_in_possession_action(State, Year),
    !.

legal_defense_recognized_in_possession_action(_State, _Year, _Defense) :-
    !,
    fail.

% Apply to the scenario: if tenant raises a retaliatory eviction defense in a possession action,
% and Iowa law recognizes such a defense in 2021, answer is yes.
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    jurisdiction(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    action(eviction_action1),
    action_type(eviction_action1, possession),
    tenant_raises_defense(tenant1, retaliatory_eviction, eviction_action1),
    legal_defense_recognized_in_possession_action(State, Year, retaliatory_eviction),
    !.

housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that eviction was retaliatory?
